Outside risk外部风险 What could hit from abroad外部可能的冲击
Pressure coming from outside China — US interest rates, the yuan, the gap between US and Chinese yields, and how many stocks are joining in. It sets the backdrop for how big to trade. It never removes a name and never changes the board's order.来自中国以外的压力 — 美国利率、人民币汇率、中美利差，以及有多少个股在参与。它决定该用多大仓位，但绝不剔除任何标的，也不改变看板排序。

How to read this如何看懂 Four lanes, left to right四个分栏，从左到右
Buy now立即买入 A clean entry point today.今天有干净的入场点。
In favour看好 Still good — but it has run. Wait for a dip.依然看好 — 但已经涨过。等回调。
Bottoming洗盘观察 Beaten down, first signs of turning up. Watch only — never a buy signal.超跌后初现回升迹象。仅供观察 — 绝非买入信号。
Reduce / avoid减仓·回避 The trend is weakening.趋势正在转弱。
A name can honestly sit in two lanes at once — weakening, yet bottoming. We show both reads rather than pick one for you.同一名称可以同时出现在两栏 — 趋势转弱，却已在筑底。我们把两种判读都显示，而不是替你二选一。

Theme cycles主题周期

?Each theme is a curated basket of A-shares with its own turn model, and the rail shows where that basket sits in its cycle. Every member is then placed in exactly one column, so a row adds up to the whole basket; a name counts once, at its most actionable state, and a name can sit in more than one theme. The cycle read is a place to look, not a measured edge — no horizon of it has cleared a significance bar.
